description: This file defines the public API and data structures for the TR-069 Device.WiFi object, modeling WiFi interfaces such as Radio, SSID, AccessPoint, and EndPoint, including class declarations, constants, and documentation.

classes.name: WiFiDevice
classes.description: Represents a WiFi device instance, manages context and device ID, provides singleton access methods.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi
classes.description: Provides interface methods for managing WiFi components such as Radio, SSID, AccessPoint, and EndPoint tables, including get/set functions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of WiFiDevice or hostIf_WiFi for a given device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the singleton instance.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_RadioNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of Radio table entries.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSIDNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of SSID table entries.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_AccessPointNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of AccessPoint table entries.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPointNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of EndPoint table entries.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EnableWiFi
methods.description: Gets the current WiFi enable/disable status.
